ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that ship A is in the direction $30^\circ$ north of east from lighthouse P, ship B is in the direction $70^\circ$ south of east from lighthouse P, and ship C is on the bisector of $\angle APB$. How many degrees north of east is ship C from lighthouse P?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $PC$ bisects $\angle APB$ and $\angle APB=80^\circ$,
\[\therefore \angle APC= \frac{1}{2}\angle APB= \frac{1}{2}\times 80^\circ=40^\circ.\]
\[\therefore \angle NPC=\angle APN+\angle APC=30^\circ+40^\circ=\boxed{70^\circ}.\]
Therefore, the ship C is in the direction of 70$^\circ$ north by east from the lighthouse P.
